t: The JG Speedfit Plastic Push-Fit Tank Connector 15mm provides a reliable and efficient plumbing solution for water systems. This straight push-fit connector is ideal for connecting pipes to cold water storage tanks and is suitable for drinking water applications. Installation is quick and easy, requiring only hand tightening onto copper tube without the need for additional tools. It is fully demountable and reusable, offering flexibility for future adjustments or repairs. Suitable for both hard and soft water areas, operating effectively between 4°C and 50°C.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
Hand Tightening Only: No Tools Required
